name: Design C: Python-first 2.5D on the flat map, no globe library; pydeck/MapLibre globe as a gated later phase
status: Research design; nothing ships. Only this file was written.

host.task_constraints_describe: payload/, desktop/, self-test, 50 MiB zipball and rule 2 installers describe the parked app.
host.current_host: Since D27 (2026-10-14) the product is a static website, built by Python every 10 min (website.yml:15) and served by GitHub Pages. This design targets the app as the task states.
website_mapping: No self-test, zipball or installer applies; a merge to main is live in about 10 min (AGENTS.md).
Vendored bytes and phone performance decide the library, not the zipball cap (supervisor log, ARCHITECTURE SHIFT).
Producers: website/gridded.py and build.py. Hand-written browser code: map.js and base.html:167-168 (rule 4).
Pages: 1 GB per site, 100 GB/month soft (gh-pages-1, -2); Actions terms and schedule limits are owner or legal items (risks 6-7).

summary: Recommended first build, C2: no globe library. Python builds fixed-region PNG layers and fixed-transect SVG profiles: MRMS echo-top height classes from 11 of the 33 MSL levels (below-ground levels masked with a Python-built terrain grid), GOES ACHA cloud-top height classes (satellite estimate, not corrected for parallax) and a GOES Band 13 picture. The browser shows them as Leaflet overlays on the vendored Leaflet 1.9.4 map and runs 6 new small duties. C1 (pydeck to a MapLibre globe with deck.gl) is a gated Phase 5 decision: pydeck 0.9.3 has no GlobeView class, deck.gl 9.4.0 has no VolumeLayer, GlobeView is marked experimental, pydeck's HTML loads third-party resources even offline, and the app would need numpy (a new installer).
recommendation: C2 first. C1 only if the owner approves D-G1 and duties G1-G8. Neither option renders true 3D storm volumes; the 3D wish is met only in part by either.

C2_flat_map_2_5d.what_it_is: Leaflet 1.9.4 (already vendored) with Python-built image overlays and SVG profiles. No globe, no WebGL, no new library.
cannot_do_that_owner_asked: Rotate, tilt or orbit; show storm columns or volumes in 3D.
Place cloud tops at true height: they are drawn as height classes, with the uncorrected offset disclosed (parallax.json).
Look like a globe (it stays a Mercator map).
Profile any clicked line: only fixed, pre-built transects.
Animate between frames: 10-minute pictures; no interpolation (rule 5).
C2_flat_map_2_5d.protects: Rule 4 and D1 (Python builds all data; no framework; no new library); the no-CDN rule; offline states; phone bytes (0.66 MB per build); honest estimate labels; reuse of gridded.py.

C1_globe_pydeck_maplibre.what_it_is: pydeck 0.9.3 as a Python spec builder driving a MapLibre globe projection with deck.gl 9.4.0 layers, in a custom page.
cannot_do_that_owner_asked: Show volumes without custom GLSL: deck.gl 9.4.0 dist.min.js has 0 matches for VolumeLayer (live, 2026-10-17); setTexture3DData has 1.

Offer a pydeck 'GlobeView': none exists. deck.py lines 93-95: 'Map projection to use with map_provider=maplibre. Values can be globe or mercator.' deck.gl GlobeView: 'This class is experimental'. MapLibre: 'Globe View or Globe Projection was released as part of MapLibre GL JS 5.0.0' (live, 2026-10-17).

Run offline from pydeck's own page: index.j2 loads a Mapbox or Google Maps script (lines 6-10), maxcdn CSS (11-12) and unpkg CSS (13); the widget stylesheet is always jsDelivr (html.py:37, index.j2:15). offline=True inlines the 4,269,385 B bundle (html.py:49-53) but keeps those links.
Use pydeck's default basemap: map_styles.py points at basemaps.cartocdn.com, which D9 says needs a key.
Guarantee WebGL2 on crew laptops: WebView2 WebGL2 is unstated; MSHTML has none (webgl-runtime.json).
C1_globe_pydeck_maplibre.protects: A real globe and 3D columns on desktops and tablets, and volumes, once parallax is corrected (plan Phase 2).

js_duties: E1 [existing; map.js:1400] Frame playback timer. Reason: frame advance is a timer in the viewer's browser.
E2 [existing; map.js:1449-1452] Scrub by pointer. Reason: pointer position exists only in the browser.
E3 [existing; map.js:1493] Layer menu open, close, tap-outside. Reason: DOM events.
E4 [existing] Town sheet and List show and hide on tap. Reason: DOM show and hide.
E5 [existing; map.js:1727-1730] Geolocation request and marker. Reason: navigator.geolocation exists only in the browser.
E6 [existing; map.js:116-119] Same-origin fetch of data/*.json with plain-words failures. Reason: the browser makes the request.
E7 [existing; base.html:167-168; map.js:1682] Page-age check; warning past 25 min. Reason: the viewer's clock.
N1 [C2 new] Layer switch and opacity for echo-top and cloud-top overlays. Reason: DOM control state only.
N2 [C2 new] Rolling echo-top window on the existing timeline (reuses E1-E2). Reason: same timer; no new geometry.
N3 [C2 new] Show one of three pre-built transect SVGs. Reason: choosing a file is a DOM event.
N4 [C2 new] Per-layer 'could not load' text on image or SVG error. Reason: only the browser sees a failed request.
N5 [C2 new] Per-layer age clock, updated each minute. Reason: the viewer's clock; Python cannot know it.
N6 [C2 new] Accessible names and aria-pressed on new controls. Reason: attributes are set in the DOM.
G1 [C1 only] Load vendored globe modules; '3D view could not load' on failure. Reason: modules execute in the browser.
G2 [C1 only] WebGL2 probe before creating the globe. Reason: only the browser knows its GPU context.
G3 [C1 only] webglcontextlost and restored handling. Reason: GPU events exist only in the browser.
G4 [C1 only] Turn Python layer JSON into deck.gl layer props. Reason: hand-written glue between data and library.
G5 [C1 only] Fetch per-frame data; set layer data on time change. Reason: browser network and timing.
G6 [C1 only] Upload per-frame 3D textures for volumes. Reason: GPU upload is browser-only; no VolumeLayer means hand-written shader code.
G7 [C1 only] Vertical exaggeration control, labelled on screen. Reason: UI event setting a shader uniform.
G8 [C1 only] Reset-view button and keyboard camera keys. Reason: UI events; the library handles drag.
js_duty_counts: Existing 7 (approved in D28). C2 adds 6: 13 in all. C1 adds 8: 21 with C1.

integrity_policy: Exact versions only. Each vendored file's sha256 is in a manifest the build checks; a test fails on mismatch. Files come from the site, never a CDN; a test finds no URL outside the site in built HTML, JS, CSS or JSON. New versions need 14 days of age (proposal). No paid token or key in browser code. The app's Folium Leaflet 1.9.3 loads from jsDelivr with no integrity attribute (folium.py:27, read live); D23's 'Folium bundles Leaflet' needs a correction entry.

evidence_kinds_and_freshness.loud_failure: Every product key must exist in sources.CONTRACTS and FRESH_SECONDS; a unit test fails on a missing key. The silent 3600 s default (weather.py:232) is not allowed.

alert_null_geometry: Matching unchanged: polygon contains the place; else UGC zone, county or fire-zone codes (rule 6; D10).
Geometry present: warning polygon outline with event name and end time. No fill colour by severity.
Null geometry matched by zone: dashed NWS forecast-zone outline, labelled 'the alert names this zone; the warning area is not given', plus marker and text at the town.
Zone matched, outline missing: marker and text 'Alert names this zone; outline not available'. Never omitted.
Town check failed: 'Alerts not checked' with age (D27). Never 'no alerts'.
Parity on three fixtures (zone-only, out-of-state, cancel during outage): map and Now-page lists identical, 3 of 3.
No height or extrusion encoding of alerts, candidates or hazards.

storms_handling.levels: MRMS heights are heightAboveSea, 500-19,000 m (mrms.json); labels say 'above sea level'. Billings ground is 952 m (terrain.json): 0.5 km is 452 m below ground there; 1.0 km is 48 m above. mrms.json lists below-ground status across Montana as open; P0 measures it.
storms_handling.below_ground_mask: A level is below ground when its height is under ground + 50 m (about twice the DEM-to-NWS gap at KBIL, 20-27 m). Below-ground levels never make an echo top and are not drawn. No terrain grid means the echo layer is Unavailable.
storms_handling.no_data_codes: MRMS -99 and -999 both mean 'No radar data' (grey hatch); meanings unverified (mrms.json). Never 0 dBZ; blank is never 'clear'. Test: missing never becomes 0 dBZ.
storms_handling.echo_top_definition: Highest valid level at or above 35 dBZ among the 11 levels, above the mask; the level's own height, not interpolated. Height classes use one sequential palette, never a severity ramp (rendering-options.json). Valid columns with no level at or above 35 dBZ read 'No echo at 35 dBZ or more; not an all-clear'.
storms_handling.parallax: Does not apply to MRMS (a ground-grid product). It applies to satellite cloud tops only.
storms_handling.legend_echo: Radar echo top (estimate): the highest level at or above 35 dBZ, height above sea level, from NOAA MRMS data. Radar estimate only: not hail, not hail size, not damage. Grey = no radar data. Blank = no echo at 35 dBZ or more, which is not an all-clear.
storms_handling.legend_cloud: Not corrected for cloud-top height. The cloud top is drawn where the satellite's ground grid puts it, away from the satellite (north-west or north-east of Montana): about 3 to 4 km off for a 2 km top, about 20 to 33 km off for a 12 to 15 km top. Estimated cloud-top height (satellite estimate). Cloud base is not observed. (parallax.json ui_legend_uncorrected_phase1, verbatim.)
storms_handling.no_interpolation: None across time (missing slot shows as a gap; missing_slot_shown_as_gap = 1.000), levels or space. Transects sample the nearest cell.
storms_handling.vertical_scale: Profiles state the stretch on screen, e.g. 'Vertical scale x2'.
storms_handling.dropped: Extruded walls, storm-motion arrows, arrival times, probability shells, hatch used as severity.

default_off_setting.app: DEFAULTS['view_3d'] = False (pattern of app.py:64-71; read through setting(), 220-221). /globe returns 200 with 'The 3D view is off. Turn it on in Settings.' Data routes and /static/globe/* return 404 while off.
default_off_setting.website: Build flag --experimental-3d, default off (build.py:481-487). The default build writes no echo, cloud, satellite or transects files and no 3D strings (tested on _site). The flagged build labels each layer 'Experimental'.
default_off_setting.exposure: Not linked from the Now page until P2 passes. Homeowner, adjuster and insurer use is out of scope until the owner decides.

route_security_tests: App: GET /globe without the hw_session cookie returns 403 (launcher.py:157-170).
App: symlinks inside static/globe are refused.
App: with view_3d off, /globe/data/* and /static/globe/* return 404.
App: /globe carries Content-Security-Policy (default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none') and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff; the app sends neither today.
App: no response contains a key, token or secret-looking query string.
App: frames carry ETag and max-age 600 s; a frame over 300 KB or SVG over 30 KB fails the budget test.
Website: built files reference no host outside the site; no inline event attributes; no eval; fetch only to same-origin data/*.json.
Website: Pages cannot set headers, so any CSP is a meta tag, which ignores frame-ancestors (standard behaviour, not checked live).

risks_ranked: 1. JavaScript scope creep against rule 4 and roadmap Next 9: C1 adds 8 hand-written duties, one of them GLSL. Mitigation: C2 first; owner sign-off per C1 duty.
2. Parallax over-reading: uncorrected tops sit 3-4 km off for 2 km tops and 20-33 km off for 12-15 km tops (parallax.json). Mitigation: verbatim legend; no fly-to.
3. Cloud-top validity: no ground truth; Montana valid cells correlate r = -0.62 with Band 13 brightness temperature (goes-aws.json). Mitigation: 'estimated' label; acha metrics.
4. Below-ground levels: 0.5 km is 452 m below ground at Billings. A wrong mask mislabels heights. Mitigation: margin mask; unmasked echo never drawn.
5. -99 and -999 meanings unverified (mrms.json). Mitigation: both read 'No radar data'; NSSL table check in P0.

6. Licence and terms: GOES files say 'Access is restricted to approved users only' while NODD says open (goes-aws.json); Actions terms say develop and test (gh-terms-1, -3). Mitigation: counsel reading before P1.
7. Schedule reliability: 5-min floor, delays, drops, 60-day disable (gh-sched-1, -2, -4, -6). Mitigation: next_expected_utc timestamps; 25-min page-age warning.
8. Phone and cellular cost unmeasured: C1 loops 14-100 MB per 2 h (rendering-options.json); no device tests exist.
9. App path: numpy and eccodes (62.16 MB Linux wheels, no Windows eccodes wheel); WebView2 WebGL2 unverified (webgl-runtime.json). C2 avoids all three.
10. pydeck's template loads third-party resources and bundles MapLibre 5.14.0 and deck.gl ~9.3 (index.j2:6-15; frontend_semver.py). Mitigation: no pydeck HTML page.
11. Self-test blind spot: HTTP status only (updater.py:141-142). Mitigation: dev-only browser job; smoke_map.py extended.
12. Silent freshness default: unknown keys get 3600 s (weather.py:232). Mitigation: loud-failure test.
13. Sample pictures are invented; real frame sizes need P0 measurement.
owner_decisions: D-G1: allow a globe library at all? C2 first; C1 only as a later, gated phase.
JS scope: approve the 13 C2 duties; decide whether C1 duties G1-G8 are ever allowed (roadmap Next 9).
Cloud product: ACHAC 10 km (0.32 MB per 5-min step; 1,777 Montana cells, 41% valid) or ACHA2KMC 2 km (4.4-4.5 MB per step; 44,363 native cells).
Legal: may GOES ACHA and MRMS-derived products be published on Pages from Actions (ACHA banner; Actions terms; gh-pages-6)? Counsel needed.
Terrain: build the grid (the mask needs it) and choose the source (AWS Terrain Tiles or USGS 3DEP; terrain.json).
Storm thresholds: 35 dBZ top first (proposed), or 50 dBZ first and 20 dBZ later (20 dBZ is 10.3 MB per peak frame).
Three fixed transects, named before any data are viewed.
Phase 1: show the uncorrected cloud layer with disclosure, or wait for parallax correction.
Default: keep all 3D and height layers out of the default build until P3 passes (proposal).
Audience: may 3D or height views reach homeowners, adjusters or insurers? This design assumes not.
Host: the website (D27) or the resumed app? This design assumes the website.
